scheme_name: HIMUDA Industrial Area Startup Plot Scheme
overview: The HIMUDA Industrial Area Startup Plot Scheme is a state-level initiative by the Himachal Pradesh Government through HIMUDA (Himachal Pradesh Urban Development Authority) to provide developed industrial plots to startups in designated industrial areas. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and industrial growth by offering land at concessional rates with infrastructure support. It targets early-stage ventures seeking physical space for operations within Himachal Pradesh.
objectives: To provide developed industrial plots to startups at concessional rates
To promote entrepreneurship and industrial development in the state
To offer plug-and-play infrastructure facilities in HIMUDA-developed industrial areas
To support job creation and regional economic growth through startup establishment
eligibility: Startups registered under the Startup India initiative or recognized by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) are eligible to apply for the scheme. The applicant must be a legal entity incorporated in India and should intend to set up its operations in the industrial areas developed by HIMUDA in Himachal Pradesh.
benefits: Allotment of developed industrial plots in HIMUDA-developed industrial areas at subsidized rates. The plots come with basic infrastructure such as road connectivity, water supply, drainage, and electricity provision. Beneficiaries also get facilitation in obtaining necessary clearances and approvals for setting up their units.
financial_support: Financial support is provided in the form of subsidized land allotment where the cost of the plot is offered at a concessional rate compared to market prices. The exact quantum of subsidy or pricing details are not specified in the available evidence. There is no mention of direct grants, loans, or equity support under this scheme.
application_process: 1. Visit the official HIMUDA website or contact the concerned office to obtain application details. 2. Check eligibility and ensure DPIIT recognition or Startup India registration. 3. Submit the application form along with required documents to the HIMUDA office. 4. Application is scrutinized by the authorities. 5. If found eligible, the applicant is intimated for plot allotment. 6. Upon approval, lease agreement is signed and plot possession is handed over after payment of dues.
required_documents: DPIIT recognition certificate or Startup India registration proof
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline mentioned in the evidence. Applications are accepted subject to plot availability.
caveats: Plot allotment is subject to availability in HIMUDA-developed industrial areas
Beneficiary must commence operations within the stipulated time frame as per allotment terms
Transfer or subletting of the allotted plot may be restricted as per HIMUDA regulations
The scheme does not provide financial assistance for construction, machinery, or working capital
